name: Verona Big & Blind 2024
information:
**Note: you will have to pay extra at the venue €10 if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
It's free, discover how to in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MuggioICQualifier2024#46643-registration-registrazione-faq).**
This venue will also host the competition FMC Europe 2024 on saturday morning. Read more in the [FMC Europe tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VeronaBigBlind2024#48603-fmc-europe-2024)

-------

**Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy.
È gratis, scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MuggioICQualifier2024#46643-registration-registrazione-faq).**
Questa venue ospiterà anche la competizione FMC Europe sabato mattina. Scopri di più nella [sezione FMC Europe](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VeronaBigBlind2024#48603-fmc-europe-2024)
